newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks soft in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks soft in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were soft on early morning Friday as investors were reluctant to take up fresh positions after a national holiday on Thursday and before the weekend, brokers said. They said signs of weakness on Wall Street were weighing down the market.
At 0014 GMT, the benchmark 225 was down 61.19 points or 0.29 percent at 20,809.64. Its December futures were down 50 points at 20,860.
"The falls should not be drastic, but there are few factors to buy on and the market is likely to hover within a narrow band," said Yasuo Ueki, Nikko Securities general manager.
